notes:
This repository contains two meteorological datasets collected at the Krummendeich Research Wind Farm (WiValdi) by the Deutsches Zentrum für Luft- und Raumfahrt (DLR e.V.). The data includes interpolated vertical profiles from combined mast and remote sensing instruments, alongside surface meteorological observations from a microwave radiometer ground station. Both datasets use a unified time base.

Dataset 1: Interpolated Vertical Profiles of Wind, Temperature, and Turbulence

The dataset 20260405_1807_interpolated_profiles.nc provides interpolated vertical profiles of wind, temperature, and turbulence derived from a combination of meteorological mast measurements and remote sensing instruments.





Instruments: IEC+ Mast, Windcube-200S, RPG-Hatpro-G5




Time Period: 2026-04-05 18:07 to 2026-04-05 18:17




Format: NetCDF4 (HDF5), CF-1.8 Conventions




Dimensions: time (198), height (198)




Missing Values: _FillValue: -9999.0



Variables





time / seconds since 2001-01-01 00:00:00: Time (Gregorian calendar)




height / m: Height above ground level




wind_speed / m s-1: Wind speed




turbulence_intensity / %: Turbulence intensity




temperature / K: Air potential temperature




wind_direction / degree: Wind direction



Dataset 2: Microwave Radiometer Surface Meteorological Data

The dataset 20260405_ground_met.nc contains ground station surface meteorological observations resampled to 10-minute intervals.





Station Name: DLR HATPRO




Instruments: HATPRO Microwave Radiometer (Surface Sensors)




Time Period: 2024-03-22 00:00 to 2024-03-23 23:59




Format: NetCDF4 (HDF5), CF-1.8 Conventions




Dimensions: time (288)




Missing Values: _FillValue: nan



Variables





time / seconds since 2001-01-01: Time (Gregorian calendar)




temp / K: Air Temperature




rhum / %: Relative Humidity




pres / hPa: Air Pressure




wspd / m s-1: Wind Speed




wdir / degree: Wind Direction




rain / mm h-1: Rain Accumulation




rainflag / 1: Rain Flag (0 = no rain, 1 = rain)




mixing_ratio / kg kg-1: Humidity Mixing Ratio




theta / K: Potential Temperature




theta_v / K: Virtual Potential Temperature




lat / degrees_north: Latitude




lon / degrees_east: Longitude




alt / m: Altitude



Dataset 3: Wind turbine data

The NREL 5MW wind turbine geometry and forces information is provided, scaled to the dimensions of the WiValdi wind turbines in the files NREL5MW.zip.



NREL5MW.vel: velocity dependent information

scaled_NREL5MW.geo: rotor geometry information



NREL5MW.cl: lift information






NREL5MW.cd: drag information

 




Dataset 4: Wake Model Input Configuration

The configuration file setup_input.json providing the site layout, ambient meteorological conditions, and turbine specifications intended as a baseline input for wake modeling software (e.g., FLORIS, PyWake).





Format: JSON



Key Components





layout: Spatial coordinates of the wind turbines.





x / m: Longitudinal coordinates




y / m: Latitudinal coordinates






ambient_conditions: Environmental reference parameters.





wd / degree: Wind direction




ws / m s-1: Wind speed




ti / 1: Turbulence intensity (expressed as a decimal fraction)






turbine_specs: Technical specifications for the modeled turbines.





name: Turbine identifier




diameter / m: Rotor diameter




hub_height / m: Hub height




yaw / degree: Nacelle yaw angle




ws_curve / m s-1: Reference wind speeds for performance curves




power_curve_kw / kW: Power curve corresponding to ws_curve




ct_curve / 1: Thrust coefficient curve corresponding to ws_curve





Further Information





Institution: Deutsches Zentrum für Luft- und Raumfahrt (DLR e.V.)
